decision.reason: Production already assigns one denominator replay per query to an otherwise-idle wave, overlapping exact scalar denominator work with the four output waves' PV chains. Moving the replay onto output wave zero serializes denominator plus PV on that wave and makes it the straggler at the existing end-of-stage barrier.

decision.do_not_retry: Do not move the exact ordered denominator from the retained idle producer onto an output wave. The current idle-wave overlap is already the correct exact schedule.
